## Specific task description

Task instruction: Grab the small smooth brown-rimmed bowl, stack them one by one.

Task description: Stack the three small bowls, which have teal-green interiors and brown rims. There are two on the left and one on the right.

Success criteria: Stack all three bowls on the table with adjacent bowls approximately aligned in both horizontal directions. The bottom bowl must remain near the table and the middle and top bowls sit low and nest compactly, without an excessively elevated stack. Both grippers must be open.

## Execution tips

- Choose a rim section facing open table space and grip along its local wall normal with one finger inside and one outside. Match the opening to wall thickness and surrounding clearance rather than spanning the whole opening.
- Before closing, confirm the pads surround the inner and outer walls below the rim rather than only the fingertips touching the rounded edge. During a slight lift, check sliding or tilting so the bowl can promptly return to support for adjustment.
- Keep the bowl opening facing up during transport. Make any needed reorientation where there is room near the center of the table, and leave clearance to route around the tall bottle and other bowls at the back right.
- While nesting, slowly lower the upper bowl bottom into the lower opening. If one rim side contacts first or the body tilts, lift slightly and adjust position rather than forcing it down and tipping the lower bowl.
- Watch outer-finger clearance from the lower bowl rim near placement. Release once the upper bowl is securely supported and withdraw upward to avoid fingers trapped between walls or lifting the bowl during retreat.
